Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.0.5

- Rebuilt axe previews with clearer facing, rarity-specific halos, and improved drag direction.
- Added five collectible axe skins and five prestige levels, each with five new axe upgrades.
- Ancient, Celestial, Divine, and Godly case rewards now receive a dedicated reveal.
- Case spins cannot be closed or canceled before the reel stops.
- Added the post-update changelog completion screen.
